versions.content: MetaData support is required if J1939TpConnection.ac- ceptVariableSA is used The usage of J1939TpConnection.acceptVari- ableSA requires the support of COM Stack MetaData with MetaDataType = SOURCE_ADDRESS_16. Please note that this affects only J1939TpConnection. tpPg.sdus that in turn are referenced by a PduTriggering that references an IPdu- Port with communicationDirection = in (in other words Rx Pdus).
